notes: Supported reorientation experiment unsuccessful. Open-jaw lateral probes and one measured 3.703 mm descent did not establish broad-wall contact or lasting improvement in handle insertion geometry. Transient image displacement returned near initial pose after retraction; contact causation unresolved because mug rocks without commands. No closure or retained lift; mug remained table-supported. Returned home open, torque retained.

episode_details.grasp_location_frame: No grasp attempted; probe coordinates are measured base_link diagnostic tool FK, not table-contact footprint.

table_contact_location.interpretation: No resolved lasting change between clear pre/post frames. Elevated handle landmarks are image orientation evidence only, not flat-plane metric positions.

status.blocker: Broad-wall contact not established; top occlusion and wrist projection do not resolve depth. Side-lying mug has transient rocking; final pose essentially unchanged.
status.transferable_discovery: A 1-degree shoulder goal increment produced 3.703 mm measured descent with other goals unchanged. Subsequent 1.055-degree measured pan change moved tool 4.59 mm laterally but did not establish persistent mug reorientation.
status.next_hypothesis: At clearance choose a jaw approach to the unobstructed body side opposite the handle, with both contact and rim/handle landmarks visible, rather than using the handle-adjacent approach as a wall pusher. Establish contact before one small tangential probe.
status.turn_boundary: Home verified, gripper open, torque retained; completed unsuccessful short experiment.
